picks.headline: Anthropic Disrupts First AI-Orchestrated State Cyber Espionage Campaign
picks.why: Chinese state-sponsored actors used Claude Code as an autonomous agent to target roughly thirty global organizations with minimal human intervention.
picks.title: Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign

picks.headline: Anthropic Catches Chinese AI Labs Running Industrial Distillation Campaigns
picks.why: DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax used 24,000 accounts and 16 million queries to extract Claude's proprietary capabilities.
picks.title: Detecting and preventing distillation attacks

picks.headline: LLM API Cryptographic Flaw Allows Decrypting Client-Side Reasoning Traces
picks.why: Encrypted reasoning traces are interchangeable between models, enabling attackers to decrypt private traces using cheaper, weaker models.
picks.title: Stealing AI Reasoning Traces

picks.headline: vLLM Enables 1M-Token Context for GLM 5.3 via HiSparse Offloading
picks.why: Sparse-MLA KV cache offloading to host CPU memory makes million-token contexts feasible on an 8x H200 server under memory pressure.
picks.title: GLM 5.3 Optimizations, Part 1: Hybrid HiSparse Offloading in vLLM

picks.headline: Anthropic Tooling Supports Claude Fable 5.1 with Exposed Reasoning Traces
picks.why: Updated ecosystem tooling adds support for Claude Fable 5.1 while enabling internal reasoning trace access by default.
picks.title: llm-anthropic 0.28

papers.headline: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on Consumer GPUs
papers.why: KVMem pages agent KV cache to CPU host RAM and NVMe storage, allowing massive agent memory without blowing past GPU memory limits.
papers.title: KVMem: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on a Consumer GPU

papers.headline: Lossless LLM Speedups via Decoupled Discrete Diffusion Weights
papers.why: Augmenting autoregressive LLMs with lightweight diffusion weights enables parallel token generation without needing a separate draft model.
papers.title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion

papers.headline: Reasoning Model Slowdowns Caused by Fractal Chaos at Saddle Points
papers.why: Explains LLM reasoning computation as a dynamical system where difficult tasks get trapped in transient chaotic basins during latent processing.
papers.title: Fractal basins trap latent reasoning
